reason: It isn't open yet, so there are no reviews and I can't see how clean it is, and I won't commit to a membership for a place my kids haven't touched. With the drive and gas, $59 a month only makes sense if we'd go a lot, and I don't know that yet.
objection: I can't tell how clean it will be. Babies and toddlers are mouthing everything, and I need reviews and to see it myself before I pay. The drive and gas also make a monthly membership hard to justify.
would_change_my_mind: Open reviews from other moms saying it's spotless, a clear cleaning and sanitizing routine posted, and a free or cheap trial visit before I commit to a membership.
